text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged into the main project. One of their biggest benefits is catching bugs early; a fresh pair of eyes can spot logic errors or typos that the original author might miss, saving time and money later. Beyond this, reviews promote knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn from more experienced colleagues, and everyone becomes familiar with different parts of the codebase. This collaborative process also raises overall team quality, as standards are consistently enforced. Ultimately, code reviews build stronger, more confident teams and produce more reliable software.
